preRequisites:
1. Application URL is accessible.
2. Valid user account exists in DB.
title: Verify Successful User Login with Valid Credentials
description: Ensure that a registered user can log into the portal using valid email and password.
steps:
1. Navigate to login page.
2. Enter valid email address.
3. Enter valid password.
4. Click 'Sign In' button.
expectedResults:
1. User is successfully authenticated.
2. Redirected to User Dashboard.
3. Welcome toast notification displayed.

title: Verify Account Lockout After 5 Failed Login Attempts
description: Validate security measure locking user account following 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
steps:
1. Enter valid username.
2. Enter incorrect password.
3. Click 'Sign In'.
4. Repeat steps 1-3 four additional times.
expectedResults:
1. On 5th failed attempt, error message 'Account locked due to multiple failed login attempts' is displayed.
2. User receives lockout email.

preRequisites:
1. User logged in.
2. Shopping cart contains at least 1 item.
title: Verify Successful Checkout via Credit Card Payment
description: Ensure user can complete purchase using a valid Credit Card payment method.
steps:
1. Proceed to Checkout page.
2. Enter shipping address.
3. Select 'Credit Card' payment option.
4. Enter valid card details.
5. Click 'Place Order'.
expectedResults:
1. Payment processed successfully.
2. Order confirmation page displayed with Order ID.
3. Confirmation email sent to user.

title: Verify Profile Picture Upload with Invalid File Format
description: Verify that system rejects image uploads in unsupported file formats (e.g., .pdf, .txt).
steps:
1. Navigate to Profile Settings.
2. Click 'Change Profile Picture'.
3. Select a '.pdf' document.
4. Click 'Upload'.
expectedResults:
1. Upload is rejected.
2. Error message displayed: 'Invalid file format. Please upload JPG or PNG images only.'
